info.name: Codenegar Social API
info.description:
Codenegar multi-tenant Social API.

Base path: `/api/v1`

Social routes live under `/api/v1/social/*` and require `X-API-Key`.
Tenant routes are unauthenticated (restrict in production).

Live Swagger (when server is running):
- EN: `{{base_url}}/docs` → `/openapi.json`
- FA: `{{base_url}}/docs/fa` → `/openapi.fa.json`

Static OpenAPI snapshots: `docs/openapi/openapi.en.json`, `docs/openapi/openapi.fa.json`.

Import `SocialHub.postman_environment.json` and set `base_url` + `api_key`.
